agents.title: Agent Guide
agents.subtitle: How agents work on this kit: read the right doc before building UI - most needs are already covered by a reusable primitive.
agents.orientationP1: The design system is the set of genuinely reusable UI primitives in this kit - containers, boxes, cards, progress indicators, a quiz, a tooltip. Every component has exactly one canonical doc that humans and agents read from the same source; the gallery shows that very file, so the doc on disk and the doc in the app can never drift.
agents.englishNote: The component docs are deliberately written in English: one canonical source for humans and agents alike, with no translation drift.
agents.indexLede: Find your task and open the linked docs first. This table is derived live from the registry - every registered component appears in exactly one row.
agents.indexSummary: {count} components in {groups} task groups, derived automatically from the registry. The full filterable grid lives in the gallery.
agents.loopLede: The self-maintenance gate forces a conscious decision for every new component. Follow this loop - the /new-component skill walks you through it and scaffolds everything in one pass.
agents.step1Body: If an existing component covers your need by about 80% or more, stop - use or extend it instead of building a near-duplicate.
agents.step2Body: A genuinely reusable primitive earns a registry entry. A one-off stays out - build it and record it in the exclusions file with a one-line reason.
agents.step3Body: The component file, the registry entry, the canonical doc, and a live demo case. As soon as the registry entry exists, the component appears in the gallery and in the table above automatically.
agents.step4Body: Run both checks; they must pass with the new entry counted:
agents.ctaBody: Run /new-component to do all of this the right way. The doc-writing contract lives in docs/DESIGN-SYSTEM.MD.
